```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(gluedown)
library(magrittr)

dt_csp <- params$dt_csp
hnc <- params$hnc
markers_use <- params$markers_use
dt_mpdeg <- params$dt_mpdeg
dt_mcmc <- params$dt_mcmc
dt_pg_list <- params$dt_pg_list
dt_log10like <- params$dt_log10like
```

---

## Summary

### Crime stain profile

```{r echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
sn_csp <- unique(params$dt_csp[, SampleName])
md_bullet(sn_csp, marker = "-")
```

---

## Deconvolution

### Mixture proportion and degradation parameter

```{r echo = FALSE}
datatable(dt_mpdeg,
          selection = "none",
          options = list(dom = "t", iDisplayLength = nrow(dt_mpdeg), ordering = FALSE, autowidth = TRUE),
          rownames = FALSE,
          colnames = c("Contributor", "Mixture proportion", "Degradation")
          ) %>%
            formatSignif(columns = c("MP", "Deg"), digits = 3)
```

### Genotype combination

```{r echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
n_mk <- length(markers_use)
for(i in 1:n_mk){
  print(md_bullet(markers_use[i], marker = "-"))
  
  dt_pg <- dt_pg_list[[i]]
  print(htmltools::tagList(datatable(dt_pg_list[[i]],
                                     selection = "none",
                                     options = list(dom = "tp", iDisplayLength = 10, ordering = FALSE, autowidth = TRUE,
                                     columnDefs = list(list(targets = c(hnc, hnc + 1, hnc + 2), visible = FALSE))),
                                     rownames = FALSE
                                     ) %>%
                                     formatSignif(columns = c("post_prob"), digits = 3)
                           )
        )
}
```

### Genotype per contributor

### Parameter and diagnostics

```{r echo = FALSE}
datatable(dt_mcmc,
          selection = "none",
          options = list(dom = "t", iDisplayLength = nrow(dt_mcmc), ordering = FALSE, autowidth = TRUE,
                         columnDefs = list(list(width = "200px", targets = c(0)),
                                           list(width = "150px", targets = c(1, 2, 3, 4)))),
          rownames = FALSE,
          colnames = c("Parameter", "Contributor", "Marker", "Estimated value", "Rhat")
          ) %>%
            formatSignif(columns = c("Estimated_value", "Rhat"), digits = 3)
```
